notes: v10.4 BUILD REFRESH (2026-11-03, b4603 — the paste card and the focus wake, a doubled word at the seam, brand names, notarized): Three repairs from the owner's afternoon reports, cut on his order. (1) The paste card no longer appears over a paste that landed: a paste the app confirmed is confirmed for every later check, so pressing ⌘V yourself a second later never raises the card. When the app has to wake the keyboard focus it now types a character and deletes it (the owner's own observation: a bare modifier press did not arm the cursor; typing does), never over selected text. If the card still appears twice within ten minutes, the app wakes the focus that way and pastes once more by itself. (2) A word heard twice across a long dictation's window seam is written once: when the second hearing sits under the same stretch of audio as the first, it is the same word and is dropped before it reaches the text ("Pinkai Pinkai").
